config.retention: below400GiB retain only stage-entry/exit, stage-best and latest; audited prune manifests
config.ceiling_action: continue next stage with best-val model AND optimizer; no training RNG rewind
config.carry_schedule: B only: linear .5 to 0 across 500K stage updates; resets each stage
config.carry_slot: B only: previous joint state before driver>=2, neutral id3721 otherwise; eval always neutral
config.continuity: weights AND optimizer carry at threshold; best-val weights AND optimizer at ceiling; training RNG never rewound
config.training: fresh procedural batch at current depth only; full-state loss at every driver
config.padding: X3 causal right-pad to16, sliced before metrics/loss
config.suffix_theorem: For this invertible map, a predictor restricted to a proper driver suffix with at least two omitted drivers has full-state accuracy 1/3721 (0.026874%) under uniform independent inputs; this is a suffix-only information bound, not a capacity bound on either recurrent model.

data_receipt.selection: exact X3 frozen validation pools; no test selection
